title: cystopteris fragilis subsp. diaphana
intro: Cystopteris fragilis subsp. diaphana, commonly known as the fragile fern, is a rare and delicate species of fern that belongs to the family Cystopteridaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system and reduce stress, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Cystopteris fragilis subsp. diaphana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
